metadata.title: Almost complex structures on triple blow-ups
metadata.abstract: We show that for certain smooth 4-manifolds, almost complex structures on its triple blow-up induce all its spin$^c$ structures with a non-negative-dimensional Seiberg-Witten moduli space. Since this includes all basic classes, our result provides an approximation to the simple type conjecture. Moreover, we expand a result by Dieter Kotschick showing that every finitely presented group is the fundamental group of an almost complex 4-manifold. We show that it can furthermore be chosen to have every even integer as the virtual dimension of the Seiberg-Witten moduli space of a spin$^c$ structure.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 三重blow-up上的几乎复结构与Seiberg–Witten虚维数
analysis.workSummary: 对某些光滑四流形，作者证明其三重blow-up上的几乎复结构诱导所有Seiberg–Witten模空间虚维数非负的spin^c结构，因此涵盖所有basic classes，并将其视为simple type猜想的近似。还强化任意有限表示群可为几乎复四流形基本群的结果，使某spin^c结构的Seiberg–Witten虚维数可取任意偶整数。
analysis.breakthrough: 把几乎复可实现性与SW指标范围相联，并同时控制基本群及指定虚维数。
analysis.limitations: 首个结论只针对某类四流形，具体拓扑条件须正文；近似simple type不是证明猜想，指定虚维数也不保证模空间非空。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际PDF SHA-256与本次记录一致；共7页，页数一致、文本完整提取、无短文本页。标准与点写A.I./A. I.、断行/连字符模型名称（含Danus）和AI用语补检未观察到作者自身使用披露；无披露不等同未使用AI。
